steps.en: Install from PyPI (ffmpeg on PATH for segmented sites)
steps.zh: 从 PyPI 安装（分段站点需 PATH 上有 ffmpeg）

steps.en: Point it at a page and list the streams without downloading
steps.zh: 指向页面，先列流不下载

steps.en: The site's extractor normalizes its stream list into itag/container/quality entries
steps.zh: 该站 extractor 把流列表归一化成 itag/容器/质量条目

steps.en: Download the stream you picked by its itag
steps.zh: 按挑中的 itag 下载那条流

steps.en: Fetches the bytes, joins segments via ffmpeg when needed, saves file and subtitles
steps.zh: 抓取字节，需要时用 ffmpeg 拼接分段，存成文件与字幕

value.en: A local copy of a clip from a Chinese-heavy site list, in one command with nothing to host
value.zh: 对着这份偏重中文站的列表，一条命令拿到本地文件，无需托管任何东西

sources: README.md @ develop (retrieved 2026-09-28): 'pip install you-get' (Installation); 'you-get -i ...' and 'you-get --itag=43 [URL]' (Download a video / stream listing); ffmpeg 'required dependency, for downloading and joining videos streamed in multiple parts' (Warnings); per-site extractor architecture (src/you_get/extractors/)
src/you_get/__main__.py @ develop: -l/--playlist flag (documented in prose, not README)
